facts.clause: Sylas's basic attacks will expend a charge and whirl his energized chains around him dealing bonus magic damage to enemies hit.
Sylas lashes his chains out, intersecting at his targeted location dealing damage to and slowing enemies.
Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing damage and healing himself against enemy champions.
Recast: Sylas throws his chains, pulling himself to the first enemy hit, dealing […] magic damage, and Knocking Up
Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits.
